title: How much does AC repair cost in Bur Dubai?
desc: AC service in Dubai typically costs between AED 230 to AED 765 depending on the type of service. Prices vary based on the unit's size and condition, as well as the service provider.

title: What are the signs that my AC needs immediate repair?
desc:
Common warning signs include:
  • Weak cooling performance
  • Water leakage
  • Burning smell
  • Strange noises
  • High electricity bills
  • Frequent shutdowns

title: Which AC systems do you repair?
desc:
We repair and maintain:
  • Window AC
  • Split AC
  • Central AC
  • Chiller AC
  • FCU Systems
  • Package Unit AC
  • Portable AC
  • Ducted Split AC
  • Ceiling AC
  • Inverter AC

title: How often should AC be serviced in Dubai?
desc: Most residential air conditioning systems should be professionally serviced every six months. Commercial systems and heavily used units may require more frequent maintenance.

title: Is an AMC worth it for air conditioning systems?
desc: Yes. An Annual Maintenance Contract helps reduce breakdowns, improve cooling efficiency, lower repair costs, improve indoor air quality, and extend equipment lifespan.

title: Why is my AC running but not cooling?
desc: This can happen because of dirty filters, low refrigerant levels, blocked coils, thermostat faults, compressor issues, or restricted airflow. A professional inspection can identify the exact cause.

title: Can AC cleaning reduce electricity bills?
desc: Yes. Cleaning filters, coils, and drainage systems helps the unit operate more efficiently, reducing unnecessary energy consumption.

title: Do you provide same-day AC repair near me in Bur Dubai?
desc: Yes. Depending on technician availability and the nature of the issue, same-day AC repair services may be available for residential and commercial customers.

title: What AC brands do you service?
desc: We service major brands including Daikin, LG, Samsung, O General, Mitsubishi, Carrier, York, Trane, Panasonic, Gree, Hitachi, Toshiba, Super General, Lennox, Rheem, Midea, Goodman, SKM, McQuay, and Blue Star.

title: What are the benefits of regular AC maintenance?
desc:
Regular maintenance helps:
  • Improve cooling efficiency
  • Lower electricity bills
  • Improve indoor air quality
  • Reduce breakdown risks
  • Extend equipment lifespan
  • Maintain consistent airflow
  • Protect major AC components

title: How often should AC ducts be cleaned?
desc: AC ducts should be cleaned every 2-3 years, or more frequently if you notice dust accumulation, poor airflow, or a musty smell. Regular cleaning ensures better air quality and system efficiency.
